newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish crown weakens on outflows, rate doubts.
newsitem.headline: Swedish crown weakens on outflows, rate doubts.

text.p: Yields closed mixed and the crown weakened in Sweden on Tuesday. Explanations abounded, from dividends being repatriated to a report that the repo rate was seen doubling to 8.0 percent. The longer end was pushed back by US data showing a modest increase in employment costs while the shorter end suffered from the crown as well as from recent reports saying the repo rate has bottomed out.
* Six month T-bill rate rose eight bp to 4.30 pct.
* Ten year bond yield fell six bp to 7.31 pct.
* Crown softened to 4.5340 crowns to the mark versus 4.5005 crowns on Monday.
STOCKHOLM, April 29 (Reuter) - Yields closed mixed on Tuesday and the crown softened.
"The crown might recover tomorrow considering what has happened in the debt market today," one dealer said, referring to the fall in longer yields.

The crown was hit by dividends fleeing the country and expectations of further flows. The short end was touched by the weak crown and rose sharply, helped by recent reports saying thet the repo rate has bottomed out since growth is picking up.
Weaker than expected U.S. employment cost data sent the U.S. thirty year yield sliding and sentiment spilled over to Sweden.
